name: Natsu no Owari no Nirvana
original_name: 夏の終わりのニルヴァーナ
source:
Four girls who lost their memories.
In order to judge the girls' held sins, the protagonist Karma is sent to Yamashiro academy.

What greeted him who was trembling with expectation and anxiety,
The girl who wants to die, Mihaya. The girl who bears a sin from birth, Nayu.
The girl who rejected the world, Reia. The girl who could not save the person she loved, Nono.

The peacefully calming, somewhat fleeting transient school life he spends with the girls...
That is, the last moratorium given to those girls who hold secrets in their souls, and at the same time to Karma a time of trial.

With his childhood friend Kuon who watches over Karma, he personally abides and rises to his task.
The souls which bear sins, will they return to the continuous flow of life? Or will they fall towards hell...?
And what is the true reason Karma was entrusted to the girls' judgments...?

Everything has been entrusted to the Karma's own decision.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=753493]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
四个失去记忆的女孩。为了审判女孩们所背负的罪孽，主人公因果被派往山城学园。迎接充满期待和不安而颤抖的他的是——想死的女孩美早、背负着与生俱来之罪的女孩奈优、拒绝世界的女孩玲爱、以及无法拯救所爱之人的女孩之之。他与女孩们度过的平静而略带虚幻的短暂校园生活……那是赋予这些灵魂中隐藏秘密的女孩们的最后缓刑期，同时也是对因果的试炼。在守护着因果的青梅竹马久远的陪伴下，他亲自承受并迎接着自己的使命。背负罪孽的灵魂，会回归生命的长河吗？还是会坠入地狱……？以及因果被托付审判女孩们的真正原因是什么……？一切都交给了因果自己的决定。

[译自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=753493]Getchu[/url]]
